title: My Background
description: My journey began as a kid tinkering with computer software, driven by a deep curiosity about how digital systems operate. That early fascination slowly transformed into a dedicated pursuit of understanding how the internet works and building modern web applications from the ground up.

title: Development Philosophy
description: Through years of practical engineering experience, I have learned that writing clean, self-documenting code is the single most valuable practice in software. Prioritizing modular design and readable architecture turns complex technical challenges into reliable solutions.

title: Future Focus
description: My goal remains tightly aligned with clean code principles and solid system architecture. By creating well-maintained, modular codebases that are effortless to navigate, I ensure projects remain scalable, resilient, and enjoyable for teams to build upon.
